Diagram
|-- The public value is shared by canvases, persistence and agents.
|   |-- diagramId identifies the diagram across service revisions.
|   |-- revisionId identifies an issued service revision.
|   `-- id is the local canvas content key; revision is a nonnegative number.
|-- Read-only content carries ASCII and its parsed structure.
|   |-- DiagramContent has its own revision identity and ASCII hash.
|   |-- buildDiagramContent validates printable ASCII and LF newlines.
|   |   `-- A tree is parsed with the selected supported parser version.
|   |-- Tree nodes retain labels, line coordinates and parent-child references.
|   |   `-- Fold ranges describe the lines hidden beneath a node.
|   `-- visibleContentLines requires content and collapsed node IDs.
|       `-- Unknown collapsed IDs are rejected as stale.
|-- Read-only source context relates content to source evidence.
|   |-- The content hash binds mappings and evidence to the ASCII.
|   |-- An optional binding identifies a source, repository, corpus and profile.
|   |   `-- A source-code profile requires a git-worktree corpus.
|   |-- Mappings identify evidence entities and source ranges.
|   |   `-- Evidence records retain labels and original source lines.
|   `-- Optional jumps are validated against diagram content.
|-- Validation enforces the value boundary.
|   |-- validateDiagram requires service identities and canonical rebuilt content.
|   |-- Source hashes, local mappings and evidence references must agree.
|   `-- Evidence ranges require safe relative paths and matching line counts.
|-- Source queries centralize mapping and evidence joins.
|   |-- diagramSource delegates to queryDiagramSourceContext.
|   |-- Selection queries require the region and mappings.
|   `-- Search checks entity IDs, labels, paths and symbols.
`-- Runtime revision management lies outside this value.
    |-- DiagramService issues content revisions.
    `-- Grid placements and floating panes reference or capture its information.
